title: Seal, Then Sample: Sampled Layerwise Proofs for Verifiable LLM Inference from GPT-2 to 70B
abstract: arXiv:2609.27367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Verifying outsourced language-model inference requires a precisely identified computation and an audit whose cost a service can afford. We present Sampled Layerwise Proofs (SLP), a protocol and prototype that commits the boundary activations of every chunk of an inference trace, absorbs all commitments before any challenge is drawn, and then proves a verifier-selected subset of chunks together with the chunks that bind the prompt and the answer. Audit coverage becomes a runtime parameter over one set of commitments: on a TinyLlama-1.1B trace, proving seven of 47 chunks takes 22.0% of the time and 6.8% of the proof size of proving all 47. Because proof cost is dominated by weights rather than tokens, SLP packs concurrent requests into one trace under a block-diagonal causal mask and binds the prompt and answer of each request to its slot. translated_title: 先封存，后抽样：面向GPT-2至70B规模可验证大语言模型推理的分层抽样证明
translated_abstract: 验证外包的语言模型推理需要精确确定的计算过程以及服务方可承受的审计成本。我们提出了分层抽样证明（Sampled Layerwise Proofs, SLP），这是一种协议及原型实现，它对推理轨迹中每个数据块的边界激活值进行承诺，在任何挑战被抽取之前先吸收全部承诺，然后证明由验证者选定的数据块子集，以及绑定提示与答案的数据块。审计覆盖率成为基于同一组承诺的运行时可调参数：在TinyLlama-1.1B的推理轨迹上，证明47个数据块中的7个，仅需证明全部47个数据块22.0%的时间和6.8%的证明大小。由于证明成本主要由权重而非词元数量决定，SLP在块对角因果掩码下将并发请求打包进同一条推理轨迹，并将每个请求的提示和答案绑定到其对应的槽位。十二个打包请求在181.9秒内完成证明，相比十二个独立证明少用6.5倍的时间。
tldr: 提出分层抽样证明（SLP）协议，先封存推理轨迹全部数据块的承诺再由验证者抽样证明选定子集，使审计覆盖率成为运行时可调参数，并通过将并发请求打包进单一轨迹，将可验证大语言模型推理的证明成本降低6.5倍。
en_tdlr: Sampled Layerwise Proofs (SLP) seals commitments of all inference-trace chunks before verifier-selected sampling, making audit coverage a runtime parameter, and packs concurrent requests into a single trace to cut verifiable LLM inference proof costs by 6.5x.
